question: countries intersecting bbox -92 7 -77 18
sql: SELECT name, iso_a3, subregion FROM countries WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-92, 7, -77, 18)) ORDER BY iso_a3;

question: major airports within bbox -75 -20 -45 0
sql: SELECT name, iata_code FROM airports WHERE type = 'major' AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-75, -20, -45, 0)) ORDER BY iata_code, name;

question: countries fully inside bbox 50 10 60 30
sql: SELECT name, iso_a3 FROM countries WHERE ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(50, 10, 60, 30)) ORDER BY iso_a3;

question: extent of major airports in bbox -90 -60 -30 15
sql: SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) AS bbox FROM airports WHERE type = 'major' AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-90, -60, -30, 15));

question: airports in bbox -22.1 63.9 -21.8 64.3
sql: SELECT name, iata_code, icao_code FROM airports WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-22.1, 63.9, -21.8, 64.3)) ORDER BY iata_code, name;
